info.desc: "Arca" is the self-titled third studio album by Venezuelan electronic record producer Arca, released on 7 April 2017 through XL Recordings. It is the first studio album to feature lead vocals by Arca herself, sung in her native Spanish. It was released to universal acclaim from critics. .

lists.name: Resident Advisor: The Best Electronic Records of 2000-25
Pitchfork: The 200 Best Albums of the 2010s

podcast.body: For those who followed Arca from the beginning, this album might be considered the least strong. However, its electronics are less aggressive, less experimental, and less rough, and Arca also sings on it, making it a much more accessible work. While previous works, especially the first, were technically superior and more respected in electronic circles, this album potentially brings experimental electronic culture to a broader audience. "este que ya la electrónica no está agresiva no están experimentando no están rudo también canta nos ha dejado un trabajo muchísimo más accesible."
This self-titled album was chosen as the Album of the Year by Revista Deist, a publication that aims to be cutting-edge. "para ellos el disco del año, es el disco de Arca, el disco Arca de Arca."
